name: [Ψ]Healthy Glow (C)
description:
Your powers can keep you in the bloom of health.  This can also stop or prevent an asthma attack.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Healthy Glow <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Leucocyte Acculumation

Level 14 leads to Anabolic Rejuvenation with Healthy Glow 14 + Leukocyte Accumulation 10 OR Detoxification 7 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Blood Purge 5 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Leukocyte Accumulation 10 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Detoxification 7 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Blood Purge 5 + Revitalizing Meditation 9.
Level 8 leads to Detoxification with Coagulation 7 + Healthy Glow 8 OR Healthy Glow 8 + Staunch Wound 3.
Level 5 leads to Leukocyte Accumulation.
Level 6 leads to Medicinal Touch.
Level 8 leads to Wakeful Rest with Immunostimulus 4.

name: [Ψ]Coagulation (C)
description:
By increasing the efficiency of your platelets and speeding their movement, you can slow your rate of bleeding and even prevent it before it starts.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 7 leads to Detoxification with Coagulation 7 + Healthy Glow 8 OR Healthy Glow 8 + Staunch Wound 3.
Level 5 leads to Enervating Touch with Medicinal Touch 5.
Level 5 leads to Staunch Wound.

name: [Ψ]Staunch Wound
description:
You concentrate on your injuries, and they close and the blood flow stops.

Level 3 leads to Detoxification with Coagulation 7 + Healthy Glow 8 OR Healthy Glow 8 + Staunch Wound 3.
message: You summon up the energy to close your wounds!

description.str: The first of the Staunch Wound spells.  This summons a low-power bandage--it's a bug if you have it.
The first of the Staunch Wound spells.  This summons a medium-power bandage--it's a bug if you have it.
The first of the Staunch Wound spells.  This summons a high-power bandage--it's a bug if you have it.

name: [Ψ]Leukocyte Accumulation (C)
description:
By rerouting blood and stem cells from more lightly damaged areas, you can speed the healing of your most grievous wounds at the cost of lessened healing elsewhere.  You may also use this to control an asthma attack.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Leucocyte Acculumation <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Healthy Glow

Level 10 leads to Anabolic Rejuvenation with Healthy Glow 14 + Leukocyte Accumulation 10 OR Detoxification 7 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Blood Purge 5 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Leukocyte Accumulation 10 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Detoxification 7 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Blood Purge 5 + Revitalizing Meditation 9.
Level 8 leads to Banish Illness with Allay Infection 12 + Leukocyte Accumulation 8 OR Allay Infection 12 + Immunostimulus 12.
Level 6 leads to Revitalizing Meditation with Allay Infection 5.

name: [Ψ]Enervating Touch
description:
With but a touch you can cause your target to begin deteriorating slowly.  This is most effective on targets with preternatural means of healing but has some effect on anyone.

Level 16 leads to Degenerating Touch with Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 OR Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 + Immunostimulus 15 OR Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Lacerating Touch 8 OR Banish Illness 6 + Immunostimulus 15 + Lacerating Touch 8.
Level 8 leads to Lacerating Touch.

description:
You can apply your Healthy Glow power to a follower or ally.  This can stop an asthma attack.

Level 5 leads to Enervating Touch with Coagulation 5.
message: Your touch your target and they seem to perk up.

name: [Ψ]Detoxification
description:
When poisoned, you can isolate the poison and move it to your sweat glands where you will harmlessly sweat it out.  While doing so, your flesh will be toxic to any creatures that take a bite.

Level 7 leads to Anabolic Rejuvenation with Healthy Glow 14 + Leukocyte Accumulation 10 OR Detoxification 7 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Blood Purge 5 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Leukocyte Accumulation 10 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Detoxification 7 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Blood Purge 5 + Revitalizing Meditation 9.
Level 8 leads to Blood Purge with Detoxification 8 + Revitalizing Meditation 6 OR Allay Infection 8 + Revitalizing Meditation 6.
Level 5 leads to Immunostimulus.

name: [Ψ]Wakeful Rest
description:
In lieu of sleep, you can meditate.  As long as you maintain your meditations, you will rarely need to spend a night sleeping.

Level 10 leads to Selective Autosomnia with Revitalizing Meditation 6.

name: [Ψ]Immunostimulus (C)
description:
Kick your immune system into overdrive in order to overcome any illnesses you may be suffering from.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 7 leads to Allay Infection.
Level 12 leads to Banish Illness with Allay Infection 12 + Leukocyte Accumulation 8 OR Allay Infection 12 + Immunostimulus 12.
Level 15 leads to Degenerating Touch with Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 OR Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 + Immunostimulus 15 OR Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Lacerating Touch 8 OR Banish Illness 6 + Immunostimulus 15 + Lacerating Touch 8.
Level 4 leads to Wakeful Rest with Healthy Glow 8.

name: [Ψ]Allay Infection
description:
Before you could stop your bleeding with but a thought.  Now, you can treat infected wounds with your powers as well.

Level 12 leads to Banish Illness with Allay Infection 12 + Leukocyte Accumulation 8 OR Allay Infection 12 + Immunostimulus 12.
Level 8 leads to Blood Purge with Detoxification 8 + Revitalizing Meditation 6 OR Allay Infection 8 + Revitalizing Meditation 6.
Level 5 leads to Revitalizing Meditation with Leukocyte Accumulation 6.
message: You concentrate on the injuries, and the itching eases.

description.str: The first of the Allay Infection spells.  This summons a low-power disinfectant/antibiotic--it's a bug if you have it.
The second of the Allay Infection spells.  This summons a medium-power disinfectant/antibiotic--it's a bug if you have it.
The third of the Allay Infection spells.  This summons a high-power disinfectant/antibiotic--it's a bug if you have it.

name: [Ψ]Revitalizing Meditation

Enter a trance state and heal your injuries many times faster than they would heal naturally.

Level 6 leads to Accelerated Resuscitation with Anabolic Rejuvenation 6 OR Banish Illness 8 + Revitalizing Meditation 6.
Level 9 leads to Anabolic Rejuvenation with Healthy Glow 14 + Leukocyte Accumulation 10 OR Detoxification 7 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Blood Purge 5 + Healthy Glow 14 OR Leukocyte Accumulation 10 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Detoxification 7 + Revitalizing Meditation 9 OR Blood Purge 5 + Revitalizing Meditation 9.

Level 6 leads to Selective Autosomnia with Wakeful Rest 10.

description:
With an inverse of vitakinesis's healing powers, you randomly tear flesh and cut blood vessels, causing significant damage in your target.

description: Use your powers to isolate and flush radiation from your body.  Depending on your level of contamination, this power may have serious side effects.

You submerge your mind into your bloodstream and remove the impurities you find there.

name: [Ψ]Selective Autosomnia
description:
You can selectively allow portions of your brain to sleep, allowing you to receive all the benefits of sleep without the disadvantages of complete unconsciousness.  This does make it slightly harder for you to focus, however.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

This power <color_red>cannot be used</color> together with the Telepathic power Concentration Trance.

description.str: Blood purge's additional ability to remove other substances contaminating your bloodstream.  It's a bug if you have it.

name: [Ψ]Banish Illness
description:
Enter a deep meditative trance and purge your body of illness, even serious ones like cancer or multiple sclerosis.  It will not cure mutation.  Some illnesses are more difficult to successfully eradicate than others.

Level 8 leads to Accelerated Resuscitation with Anabolic Rejuvenation 6 OR Banish Illness 8 + Revitalizing Meditation 6.
Level 6 leads to Degenerating Touch with Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 OR Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 + Immunostimulus 15 OR Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Lacerating Touch 8 OR Banish Illness 6 + Immunostimulus 15 + Lacerating Touch 8.
message: You attempt to cure your afflictions.

name: [Ψ]Anabolic Rejuvenation (C)
description:
You draw on your body's reserves to speed your healing a hundredfold.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

Level 6 leads to Accelerated Resuscitation with Anabolic Rejuvenation 6 OR Banish Illness 8 + Revitalizing Meditation 6.
Level 5 leads to Degenerating Touch with Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 OR Banish Illness 6 + Enervating Touch 16 + Immunostimulus 15 OR Anabolic Rejuvenation 5 + Banish Illness 6 + Lacerating Touch 8 OR Banish Illness 6 + Immunostimulus 15 + Lacerating Touch 8.

name: [Ψ]Ameliorate Extremity
description: You sink your mind the deepest within yourself you can possibly get and enter a meditative trance to rejuvenate lost limbs, one at a time.  Be sure to remove any prosthetics before doing this, it's hard to work around them.
message: You sink your mind deep within your body and enter a trance.

description: The ultimate expression of a vitakinetic's ability to reverse vital processes, this power induces massive cellular breakdown in the target, causing severe injury, weakness, and possible death.

name: [Ψ]Accelerated Resuscitation (C)
description:
While this power is active, if you suffer potentially fatal damage, your vitakinesis will go into overdrive to keep you alive.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
